observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor river bank or dry river bed with dark sand and stones, mountains and hills in the background under an overcast sky
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, appearing to be young adults, dancing in a line/group and in small groups
observation.formation_and_space: linear rows facing the camera, turning sideways, traveling across the space in lines, and pairing up
observation.posture: upright torso with relaxed, natural posture, knees slightly bent
observation.footwork: stepping side to side, hopping or skipping on the beat, lifting feet off the ground; exact heel/toe details cannot be seen due to camera distance
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held open and swinging, holding white cloths/handkerchiefs or bottles balanced on their heads
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle hip movement and torso sway accompanying the footwork
observation.partnering: group dancing alongside one another without physical partner holds, occasional parallel movement
observation.levels_jumps_turns: small jumps and hops on the beat, low jumps, a moment where dancers lie down and stand back up
observation.costume_and_props: women wear off-the-shoulder tops in bright colors (yellow, red, orange) with patterned ruffled skirts and head wraps; men wear white trousers and patterned short-sleeve button-down shirts; props include glass bottles balanced on heads and white handkerchiefs
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and precise weight transfer cannot be determined due to camera distance and wide shots

signature_moments.what: Dancers move in a line across the dark sand riverbank holding bottles balanced on their heads with arms extended.
Men in white trousers and patterned shirts step and hop while waving white handkerchiefs above their heads.
